verdict.rationale: Asana documents automation building blocks (Rules, webhooks, API, and AI Studio's 'no-code automations') that could underlie scheduled or recurring workflows, but no evidence explicitly describes a time-based/recurring trigger or cron-like scheduling capability for AI-native workflows. missing for 10: explicit recurring/scheduled trigger documentation, evidence of AI Studio or Rules supporting time-based recurrence, independent confirmation of scheduled job execution.
